name: Atexxo Zone 2 Galaxy Tab A9
statusNote: Listed by Atexxo; one distributor shows it as out of stock.
summary: The Atexxo Zone 2 Galaxy Tab A9 is a standard Samsung Galaxy Tab A9 converted by Atexxo for hazardous areas, rated for Zone 2/22 under ATEX. It is an Ex ec ic-rated design, and the tablet runs Android 16.
imageAlt: Atexxo Zone 2 Galaxy Tab A9, front view

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ec ic IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex tc IIIB T135°C Dc

certification.protection: Increased safety and intrinsic safety (Ex ec ic)

safety.certifiedAccessories: Passive stylus (on request; Ex rating not stated). Four reinforced tether / anchor points on the unit; shoulder strap mentioned on the Active5 Pro flyer only. No Ex-rated keyboard, dock or charger listed

specs.chip: Octa-core (2.2 GHz + 2 GHz); chipset name not on Samsung UK page
specs.sim: LTE model with SIM (type not stated on the page)
specs.storage: 64 GB or 128 GB, microSD up to 1 TB
specs.partNumbers: EX-TABLET-SAM-8.7-64; EX-TABLET-SAM-8.7-64-CEL; EX-TABLET-SAM-8.7-128; EX-TABLET-SAM-8.7-128-CEL; EX-TABLET-SAM-8.7-* (conversion service, tablet excluded)

throughCase.label: Apple Pencil / stylus
throughCase.value: Passive stylus on request for glove use. A9 has no S Pen support

throughCase.label: Rear cameras
throughCase.value: Yes: usable as an intrinsically safe photo/video camera per Atexxo

throughCase.label: Touchscreen
throughCase.value: Yes (glove use via passive stylus on request)

throughCase.label: Charging
throughCase.value: USB-C charger listed (100-240 V). Ex-area charging rules not stated

capabilities.label: Push-to-talk
capabilities.value: Via app (Android PTT apps; Atexxo does not list PTT)

capabilities.value: Via app (camera-based; no dedicated scan engine)

capabilities.label: NFC reading
capabilities.value: Not possible (base tablet has no NFC)

capabilities.label: 3D scanning / LiDAR
capabilities.value: Not possible (base tablet has no depth sensor)

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (front and rear cameras retained; camera marketed as an intrinsically safe video camera)

Among the lightest Zone 2 tablets of its size we list, at 780 g in use
limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
Ex marking not yet confirmed against a published certificate
Dust group IIIB: combustible flyings and non-conductive dust only, not conductive dust
